special-scheme-parsing.name: Special scheme parsing differences
special-scheme-parsing.description: One parser recognizes and preserves special schemes (e.g., wss, ldaps) while the other treats them as non-special or substitutes alternative schemes

scheme-colon-handling.name: Scheme colon handling
scheme-colon-handling.description: One parser includes the trailing colon in scheme, the other excludes it

scheme-case-normalization.name: Scheme case normalization
scheme-case-normalization.description: One parser lowercases the scheme while the other preserves its case
